dedupe_keys.name: high resolution global industrial and smallholder oil palm map for 2019

description: CREAF and collaborating research institutions publish a 10 m map of industrial and smallholder closed-canopy oil-palm plantations for 2019. The product contains 634 geographic tiles where plantations were detected, with classes for industrial plantations, smallholder plantations and other land cover. Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 composites feed the classification. Zenodo provides GeoTIFF maps, Shapefile tile indexes and 13,495 validation points with reference and predicted classes. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0. The closed-canopy definition and the potential-distribution mask limit coverage of young, sparse or unexpected plantations. This is a land-cover snapshot, not a measurement of crop output or processing capacity. The maps could supply agricultural production-area and access constraints for food-supply or freight simulations when combined with yields and mill locations. They complement data-indonesia-industrial-smallholder-oil-palm-expansion-2001-2019 with wider geographic coverage and an explicit smallholder/industrial classification, while retaining different observation periods and methods.
